title: Shimla Manali Kasol Tour Package
overview: Planning a holiday in Himachal Pradesh but finding it difficult to choose the right places? A Shimla Manali Kasol tour package can give you a mix of beautiful hill stations, peaceful valleys, adventure activities, and memorable mountain experiences in one trip. With Safar Trails, you can explore the charm of Shimla, the adventurous side of Manali, and the peaceful atmosphere of Kasol with a thoughtfully planned itinerary. The itinerary can be adjusted according to your requirements, making your trip more personal instead of following a fixed plan.
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the package
Expenses due to unexpected weather or road conditions
Special sightseeing requirements or additional services
Any other expenses not specifically mentioned in the package inclusions

itinerary.title: Delhi → Shimla
itinerary.description: Arrival in Shimla, hotel check-in and evening visit to The Ridge, Mall Road & Christ Church.

itinerary.title: Shimla & Kufri Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Explore Kufri, Green Valley, Jakhu Temple and enjoy free time at Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Shimla → Manali
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through the Himalayan valleys. Check-in at Manali and evening leisure at Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Hadimba Temple, Manu Temple, Vashisht Village, Van Vihar & Old Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali → Solang Valley → Atal Tunnel → Sissu → Kasol
itinerary.description: Enjoy scenic Himalayan views at Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel & Sissu, followed by a journey to Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol & Manikaran Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Manikaran Sahib and explore the peaceful Chalal Village. Evening leisure at Kasol Market and riverside.

itinerary.title: Kasol → Delhi
itinerary.description: Check out and begin your return journey to Delhi by private cab, enjoying scenic valley views along the way. Trip Ends.

seoTitle: Shimla Manali Kasol Tour Package – Manali Adventure & Sightseeing
seoDescription: Explore Manali with the Shimla Manali Kasol tour package. Visit Hadimba Temple, Old Manali, Mall Road and Solang Valley, with Atal Tunnel and Rohtang Pass subject to access.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Shimla, Manali and Kasol?
faqs.answer: Summer is ideal for pleasant weather and sightseeing. The monsoon brings lush green landscapes but also rain and possible road disruptions. Winter is good for travellers looking for snow, though accessibility depends on weather and road conditions. Check the latest weather and road conditions before travelling, especially for the higher-altitude stretches.

faqs.question: Who can book this Himachal tour?
faqs.answer: Families, couples, friends, solo travellers, corporate groups, school or college groups and private travel groups. Safar Trails can help you select an itinerary according to your group size, travel preferences and budget.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be changed?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can discuss your preferred travel dates, hotel category, number of travellers and the places you want to visit, and the itinerary is adjusted to suit — it is not a fixed plan.

faqs.question: Are the Atal Tunnel and Rohtang Pass included?
faqs.answer: The Atal Tunnel and Sissu are part of the Day 5 drive. The Rohtang Pass area can be added where accessible, but it depends on the season, road conditions and local permissions, so it cannot be guaranteed in advance.

faqs.question: What is not included in the package?
faqs.answer: Personal expenses, additional and adventure activities, entry tickets and attraction charges, meals not mentioned in the package, expenses arising from unexpected weather or road conditions, special sightseeing requirements or additional services, and anything not specifically listed in the inclusions.
